answer: The queue is public, and the ordering is enforced by the withdrawal contract. A farm needs 328 queue positions, since one position cannot withdraw 328 stakes. Withdrawals exit in first-in-first-out order, so no validator can jump the queue. Watch the ember: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the relic bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the island audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
